items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Mike Smith? ... [INTERVIEWER] ... with Dave and Drew Gress and the late Mike Smith on drums. ... [INTERVIEWEE] They’re the Washington contingent.
